You may want to step back and quit discussing the thought of getting back together with your ex-paramour. I know it may not seem like a big deal to you since you're used to having open relationships, but that's not okay in your ex-paramours partner's eyes. Personally, I am very monogamous when I get into a relationship myself. Any excessive flirting or reminiscing on past relationships is an instant red flag to many people who are monogamous. Sure, it may have been fun, but I think you should try to respect their boundaries with their new relationship. That doesn't mean stop talking to him entirely since you still want to be friends. Just realize he his "off limits," (Meaning anything intimate; kissing or sexual -- Even discussing the idea of possibly doing it while your friend is still in a monogamous relationship) and respect your ex-paramour and his new partner's relationship.

You shouldn't try to convince him to try and cheat on her, either.

It may help to also talk to your ex-paramour's SO directly. Let her know that you don't want to cause any trouble or worries -- as long as you truly mean it.
